description: Connect to the Yiou Data MCP service and gain in-depth access to industrial data via natural language. Core datasets including corporate investment and financing, industrial chain upstream-downstream relationships, and industry research reports are readily available. You can also retrieve Yiou's published industrial perspectives, enterprise analyses and market insights at any time to support your efficient business decision-making.
